title: Within the Father's House
description: Within the Father's House in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 7 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by James Russell Woodford, first published in 1863. The tune, FRANCONIA, is by Johann Balthasar König (1738). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: With-in the Fa-ther's house The Son hath found His home; And to His tem-ple sud-den-ly The Lord of Life hath come.

lines: The Son hath found His home;
The Lord of Life hath come.
And marvel at His gracious words
Yet not to them is giv'n
To lift the fleshly veil which hides
And teach us by Thy grace
And on the cleansèd soul shall burst
D Till we behold Thy face,
And know, as we are known,
Thee, Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
